```{cypher}
# Idempotent constraints and data loading

CREATE CONSTRAINT choleraCase IF NOT EXISTS FOR (c:CholeraCase) REQUIRE c.id IS UNIQUE;
CREATE CONSTRAINT waterPump IF NOT EXISTS FOR (w:WaterPump) REQUIRE w.id IS UNIQUE;

LOAD CSV WITH HEADERS FROM 'file:///d://temp//JohnSnow-cholera.csv' AS row
MERGE (c:CholeraCase {
    id: toInteger(row.id),
    count: toInteger(row.Count),
    longitude: toFloat(row.longitude),
    latitude: toFloat(row.latitude)
});

LOAD CSV WITH HEADERS FROM 'file:///d://temp//JohnSnow-pumps.csv' AS row
MERGE (w:WaterPump {
    id: toInteger(row.id),
    longitude: toFloat(row.longitude),
    latitude: toFloat(row.latitude)
});
```
